My name is on this land and maize is our food, so I must plan carefully. I will buy some fertilizer from the AIP program if my coupon comes through, but the prices are high so I cannot afford the full recommended amount — I will stretch it. I keep a few goats and chickens, so I will spread their manure on the weaker patches before the rains, and I will intercrop with pigeon peas like last year to help the soil. I cannot irrigate because my plot depends on the rains from Lake Malawi's weather, and I will mostly use my own hands and my wife and older children, hiring a few people only for weeding when the maize is knee-high.
